Date.description: A calendar date, YYYY-MM-DD, such as 2026-11-17.

Defaults.description:
What a new song's composition, a render and a new grid start from, each spelled as its flag
spells it. Every field is optional. A closed object: an unknown field is refused, so a typo
is caught rather than ignored. The lane map is not here: lanes are config, in
`.duet/duet.toml`.

grid.description: The step a new grid takes, such as 1/16.

key.description: The key, such as Ab major.

tempo_bpm.description: The tempo, in quarter notes per minute.

tuning.description: The tuning renders take: A4 in Hz (440, 442) or in cents from 440 Hz (+0c, -12c).

FileName.description: A file's own name, without its directory, such as Blood Sport 3.m4a.

Given.description:
Values the owner gave a take, remembered for it (decision 6). A closed object: an unknown
field is refused, so a typo is caught rather than ignored.

tempo_bpm.description: The tempo, in quarter notes per minute, as `--tempo` gives it.

Grid.description: A quantize grid such as 1/16, or 1/8t for triplet eighths.

Key.description: A key such as D minor, Bb major or D dorian, with at most 7 sharps or flats.

Name.description: A name in the project: lowercase letters and digits, words joined by single hyphens, such as wayfaring or blood-sport-v2.

Project.description: A project's document: the body of `project` 1.0.

created.description: The date the project was made.

defaults.description:
What a new song's composition, a render and a new grid start from. Capture never takes
them.

duet.description:
The `<major>.<minor>` of the duet that made the project. Information only: it is never
checked. The envelope's `tool` says who last wrote the file; this says who made the
project.

takes.description: The project's takes, each named once.

title.description: The project's name for people. `duet init` sets it from the directory's name.

ProjectTake.description: One of the project's takes: its name, its identity, and what the owner gave it.

added.description: The date the take was added.

file.description:
The source's own file name when added, without its directory. Information, for people
and for finding it again; never a path.

given.description: Values the owner gave this take, used by every later capture of it and stated as given.

name.description:
The take's name in the project, unique in it. Its directory under `takes/` and its file
stems use it.

take.description:
The take: the digest of its decoded samples, which is its identity, and their rate,
channels and frames. The type `capture-analysis` and `performance` state a take with.

Take.description:
The audio an analysis was read from: its samples' digest, and their rate, channel count and
length, as decoded.

channels.description: The source's channel count, before any downmix.

digest.description: The SHA-256 of the decoded samples ([`TakeDigest`]).

frames.description: The take's length in frames (one sample per channel) at `rate`, a filled gap included.

rate.description: The source's own sample rate, in Hz, before any resampling.

TakeDigest.description: The SHA-256 of a take's decoded samples: the bytes `duet-take-1`, the rate as a little-endian u32, the channel count as a little-endian u16, then every sample, interleaved, as the little-endian bits of its f32.

TimeSig.description: A time signature such as 4/4 or 6/8: the denominator is 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

Tuning.description: A tuning as --tuning spells it: A4 in Hz (440, 442) or cents from 440 Hz (+0c, -12c), at most 100 cents from 440 Hz.

Version.description: A kind's schema version, <major>.<minor>, such as 1.0.

description: A .duet document of kind project, at schema version 1.0.
title: duet project 1.0
